verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ(1)
verses.translation: (1) In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

verses.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَۙ‏(2)
verses.translation: (2) All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.arabic: الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِۙ‏(3)
verses.translation: (3) The Beneficent, the Merciful.

verses.arabic: مٰلِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِؕ‏(4)
verses.translation: (4) Master of the Day of Judgement.

verses.arabic: اِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَاِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِيْنُؕ‏(5)
verses.translation: (5) Thee do we serve and Thee do we beseech for help.

verses.arabic: اِهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيْمَۙ‏(6)
verses.translation: (6) Keep us on the right path.

verses.arabic: صِرَاطَ الَّذِيْنَ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۙ‏ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوْبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّآلِّيْنَ‏(7)
verses.translation: (7) The path of those upon whom Thou hast bestowed favors. Not (the path) of those upon whom Thy wrath is brought down, nor of those who go astray.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ

verses.translation: (1) Alif Lam Mim.

verses.arabic: ذٰ لِكَ الْڪِتٰبُ لَا رَيْبَۛۚۖ فِيْهِۛۚ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِيْنَۙ‏(2)
verses.translation: (2) This Book, there is no doubt in it, is a guide to those who guard (against evil).

verses.arabic: الَّذِيْنَ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَ يُقِيْمُوْنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ يُنْفِقُوْنَۙ‏(3)
verses.translation: (3) Those who believe in the unseen and keep up prayer and spend out of what We have given them.

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِمَۤا اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكَ وَمَاۤ اُنْزِلَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَۚ وَبِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوْقِنُوْنَؕ‏(4)
verses.translation: (4) And who believe in that which has been revealed to you and that which was revealed before you and they are sure of the hereafter.

verses.arabic: اُولٰٓئِكَ عَلٰى هُدًى مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمْ‌ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ‏(5)
verses.translation: (5) These are on a right course from their Lord and these it is that shall be successful.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَاَنْذَرْتَهُمْ اَمْ لَمْ تُنْذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ‏(6)
verses.translation: (6) Surely those who disbelieve, it being alike to them whether you warn them, or do not warn them, will not believe.

verses.arabic: خَتَمَ اللّٰهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوْبِهِمْ وَعَلٰى سَمْعِهِمْ‌ؕ وَعَلٰىٓ اَبْصَارِهِمْ غِشَاوَةٌ  وَّلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيْمٌ‏(7)
verses.translation: (7) Allah has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing and there is a covering over their eyes, and there is a great punishment for them.

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَّقُوْلُ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَبِالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَمَا هُمْ بِمُؤْمِنِيْنَ‌ۘ‏(8)
verses.translation: (8) And there are some people who say: We believe in Allah and the last day; and they are not at all believers.

verses.arabic: يُخٰدِعُوْنَ اللّٰهَ وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا ‌ۚ وَمَا يَخْدَعُوْنَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُوْنَؕ‏(9)
verses.translation: (9) They desire to deceive Allah and those who believe, and they deceive only themselves and they do not perceive.

verses.arabic: فِىْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّرَضٌۙ فَزَادَهُمُ اللّٰهُ مَرَضًا ‌ۚ وَّلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌۙۢبِمَا كَانُوْا يَكْذِبُوْنَ‏(10)
verses.translation: (10) There is a disease in their hearts, so Allah added to their disease and they shall have a painful chastisement because they lied.

verses.arabic: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمْ لَا تُفْسِدُوْا فِىْ الْاَرْضِۙ قَالُوْاۤ اِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُصْلِحُوْنَ‏(11)
verses.translation: (11) And when it is said to them, Do not make mischief in the land, they say: We are but peace-makers.

verses.arabic: اَلَا ۤ اِنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْمُفْسِدُوْنَ وَلٰكِنْ لَّا يَشْعُرُوْنَ‏(12)
verses.translation: (12) Now surely they themselves are the mischief makers, but they do not perceive.

verses.arabic: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمْ اٰمِنُوْا كَمَاۤ اٰمَنَ النَّاسُ قَالُوْاۤ اَنُؤْمِنُ كَمَاۤ اٰمَنَ السُّفَهَآءُ‌ ؕ اَلَاۤ اِنَّهُمْ هُمُ السُّفَهَآءُ وَلٰكِنْ لَّا يَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(13)
verses.translation: (13) And when it is said to them: Believe as the people believe, they say: Shall we believe as the fools believe? Now surely they themselves are the fools, but they do not know.

verses.arabic: وَاِذَا لَقُوْا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا قَالُوْاۤ اٰمَنَّا ۖۚ وَاِذَا خَلَوْا اِلٰى شَيٰطِيْنِهِمْۙ قَالُوْاۤ اِنَّا مَعَكُمْۙ اِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ‏(14)
verses.translation: (14) And when they meet those who believe, they say: We believe; and when they are alone with their Shaitans, they say: Surely we are with you, we were only mocking.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ وَيَمُدُّهُمْ فِىْ طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُوْنَ‏(15)
verses.translation: (15) Allah shall pay them back their mockery, and He leaves them alone in their inordinacy, blindly wandering on.

verses.arabic: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ اشْتَرَوُا الضَّلٰلَةَ بِالْهُدٰى فَمَا رَبِحَتْ تِّجَارَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوْا مُهْتَدِيْنَ‏(16)
verses.translation: (16) These are they who buy error for the right direction, so their bargain shall bring no gain, nor are they the followers of the right direction.

verses.arabic: مَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ الَّذِى اسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًا ‌ۚ فَلَمَّاۤ اَضَآءَتْ مَا حَوْلَهٗ ذَهَبَ اللّٰهُ بِنُوْرِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِىْ ظُلُمٰتٍ لَّا يُبْصِرُوْنَ‏(17)
verses.translation: (17) Their parable is like the parable of one who kindled a fire, but when it had illumined all around him, Allah took away their light, and left them in utter darkness-- they do not see.

verses.arabic: صُمٌّۢ بُكْمٌ عُمْىٌ فَهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُوْنَ ۙ‏(18)
verses.translation: (18) Deaf, dumb (and) blind, so they will not turn back.

verses.arabic: اَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فِيْهِ ظُلُمٰتٌ وَّرَعْدٌ وَّبَرْقٌ‌ ۚ يَجْعَلُوْنَ اَصَابِعَهُمْ فِىْۤ اٰذَانِهِمْ مِّنَ الصَّوَاعِقِ حَذَرَ الْمَوْتِ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ مُحِيْطٌ‌ۢ بِالْكٰفِرِيْنَ‏(19)
verses.translation: (19) Or like abundant rain from the cloud in which is utter darkness and thunder and lightning; they put their fingers into their ears because of the thunder peal, for fear of death, and Allah encompasses the unbelievers.

verses.arabic: يَكَادُ الْبَرْقُ يَخْطَفُ اَبْصَارَهُمْ‌ؕ كُلَّمَاۤ اَضَآءَ لَهُمْ مَّشَوْا فِيْهِۙ وَاِذَاۤ اَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَامُوْا‌ؕ وَلَوْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمْعِهِمْ وَاَبْصَارِهِمْ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ‏(20)
verses.translation: (20) The lightning almost takes away their sight; whenever it shines on them they walk in it, and when it becomes dark to them they stand still; and if Allah had pleased He would certainly have taken away their hearing and their sight; surely Allah has power over all things.

verses.arabic: يٰۤاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اعْبُدُوْا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِىْ خَلَقَكُمْ وَالَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُوْنَ ۙ‏(21)
verses.translation: (21) O men! serve your Lord Who created you and those before you so that you may guard (against evil).

verses.arabic: الَّذِىْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ فِرَاشًا وَّالسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَّاَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَخْرَجَ بِهٖ مِنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ‌ۚ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوْا لِلّٰهِ اَنْدَادًا وَّاَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ ‏(22)
verses.translation: (22) Who made the earth a resting place for you and the heaven a canopy and (Who) sends down rain from the cloud, then brings forth with it subsistence for you of the fruits; therefore do not set up rivals to Allah while you know.

verses.arabic: وَاِنْ کُنْتُمْ فِىْ رَيْبٍ مِّمَّا نَزَّلْنَا عَلٰى عَبْدِنَا فَاْتُوْا بِسُوْرَةٍ مِّنْ مِّثْلِهٖ وَادْعُوْا شُهَدَآءَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ‏(23)
verses.translation: (23) And if you are in doubt as to that which We have revealed to Our servant, then produce a chapter like it and call on your witnesses besides Allah if you are truthful.

verses.arabic: فَاِنْ لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوْا وَلَنْ تَفْعَلُوْا فَاتَّقُوْا النَّارَ الَّتِىْ وَقُوْدُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ  ۖۚ اُعِدَّتْ لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ‏(24)
verses.translation: (24) But if you do (it) not and never shall you do (it), then be on your guard against the fire of which men and stones are the fuel; it is prepared for the unbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِىْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ‌ؕ ڪُلَّمَا رُزِقُوْا مِنْهَا مِنْ ثَمَرَةٍ رِّزْقًا ‌ۙ قَالُوْا هٰذَا الَّذِىْ رُزِقْنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَاُتُوْا بِهٖ مُتَشَابِهًا ‌ؕ وَلَهُمْ فِيْهَآ اَزْوَاجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ ‌ۙ وَّهُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ‏(25)
verses.translation: (25) And convey good news to those who believe and do good deeds, that they shall have gardens in which rivers flow; whenever they shall be given a portion of the fruit thereof, they shall say: This is what was given to us before; and they shall be given the like of it, and they shall have pure mates in them, and in them, they shall abide.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَسْتَحْىٖۤ اَنْ يَّضْرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا ‌بَعُوْضَةً فَمَا فَوْقَهَا ‌ؕ فَاَمَّا ‌الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا فَيَعْلَمُوْنَ اَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّهِمْ‌ۚ وَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ ڪَفَرُوْا فَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَاذَآ اَرَادَ اللّٰهُ بِهٰذَا مَثَلًا ۘ يُضِلُّ بِهٖ ڪَثِيْرًا وَّيَهْدِىْ بِهٖ كَثِيْرًا ‌ؕ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهٖۤ اِلَّا الْفٰسِقِيْنَۙ ‏(26)
verses.translation: (26) Surely Allah is not ashamed to set forth any parable-- (that of) a gnat or any thing above that; then as for those who believe, they know that it is the truth from their Lord, and as for those who disbelieve, they say: What is it that Allah means by this parable: He causes many to err by it and many He leads aright by it! but He does not cause to err by it (any) except the transgressors,

verses.arabic: الَّذِيْنَ يَنْقُضُوْنَ عَهْدَ اللّٰهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مِيْثَاقِهٖ وَيَقْطَعُوْنَ مَآ اَمَرَ اللّٰهُ بِهٖۤ اَنْ يُّوْصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُوْنَ فِى الْاَرْضِ‌ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخٰسِرُوْنَ‏(27)
verses.translation: (27) Who break the covenant of Allah after its confirmation and cut asunder what Allah has ordered to be joined, and make mischief in the land; these it is that are the losers.

verses.arabic: كَيْفَ تَكْفُرُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَڪُنْتُمْ اَمْوَاتًا فَاَحْيَاکُمْ‌ۚ ثُمَّ يُمِيْتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيْكُمْ ثُمَّ اِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ‏(28)
verses.translation: (28) How do you deny Allah and you were dead and He gave you life? Again He will cause you to die and again bring you to life; then you shall be brought back to Him.

verses.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِىْ خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مَّا فِى الْاَرْضِ جَمِيْعًا ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰۤى اِلَى السَّمَآءِ فَسَوّٰٮهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ‌ؕ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيْمٌ‏(29)
verses.translation: (29) He it is Who created for you all that is in the earth, and He directed Himself to the heaven, so He made them complete seven heavens, and He knows all things.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اِنِّىْ جَاعِلٌ فِى الْاَرْضِ خَلِيْفَةً ؕ قَالُوْٓا اَتَجْعَلُ فِيْهَا مَنْ يُّفْسِدُ فِيْهَا وَيَسْفِكُ الدِّمَآءَۚ وَنَحْنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَ‌ؕ قَالَ اِنِّىْٓ اَعْلَمُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(30)
verses.translation: (30) And when your Lord said to the angels, I am going to place in the earth a khalif, they said: What! wilt Thou place in it such as shall make mischief in it and shed blood, and we celebrate Thy praise and extol Thy holiness? He said: Surely I know what you do not know.

verses.arabic: وَعَلَّمَ اٰدَمَ الْاَسْمَآءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمْ عَلَى الْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ فَقَالَ اَنْۢبِئُوْنِىْ بِاَسْمَآءِ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ‏(31)
verses.translation: (31) And He taught Adam all the names, then presented them to the angels; then He said: Tell me the names of those if you are right.

verses.arabic: قَالُوْا سُبْحٰنَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ اِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَا ؕ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَلِيْمُ الْحَكِيْمُ‏(32)
verses.translation: (32) They said: Glory be to Thee! we have no knowledge but that which Thou hast taught us; surely Thou art the Knowing, the Wise.

verses.arabic: قَالَ يٰٓاٰدَمُ اَنْۢبِئْهُمْ بِاَسْمَآئِهِمْ‌ۚ فَلَمَّآ اَنْۢبَاَهُمْ بِاَسْمَآئِهِمْۙ قَالَ اَلَمْ اَقُل لَّكُمْ اِنِّىْٓ اَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۙ وَاَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُوْنَ وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْتُمُوْنَ‏(33)
verses.translation: (33) He said: O Adam! inform them of their names. Then when he had informed them of their names, He said: Did I not say to you that I surely know what is ghaib in the heavens and the earth and (that) I know what you manifest and what you hide?

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اسْجُدُوْا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوْٓا اِلَّاۤ اِبْلِيْسَؕ اَبٰى وَاسْتَكْبَرَ  وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ‏(34)
verses.translation: (34) And when We said to the angels: Make obeisance to Adam they did obeisance, but Iblis (did it not). He refused and he was proud, and he was one of the unbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَقُلْنَا يٰٓاٰدَمُ اسْكُنْ اَنْتَ وَزَوْجُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَكُلَا مِنْهَا رَغَدًا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هٰذِهِ الشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُوْنَا مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ‏(35)
verses.translation: (35) And We said: O Adam! Dwell you and your wife in the garden and eat from it a plenteous (food) wherever you wish and do not approach this tree, for then you will be of the unjust.

verses.arabic: فَاَزَلَّهُمَا الشَّيْطٰنُ عَنْهَا فَاَخْرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيْهِ‌ وَقُلْنَا اهْبِطُوْا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ ۚ وَلَكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَّمَتَاعٌ اِلٰى حِيْنٍ‏(36)
verses.translation: (36) But the Shaitan made them both fall from it, and caused them to depart from that (state) in which they were; and We said: Get forth, some of you being the enemies of others, and there is for you in the earth an abode and a provision for a time.

verses.arabic: فَتَلَقّٰٓى اٰدَمُ مِنْ رَّبِّهٖ كَلِمٰتٍ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ‏(37)
verses.translation: (37) Then Adam received (some) words from his Lord, so He turned to him mercifully; surely He is Oft-returning (to mercy), the Merciful.

verses.arabic: قُلْنَا اهْبِطُوْا مِنْهَا جَمِيْعًا ‌‌ۚ فَاِمَّا يَاْتِيَنَّكُمْ مِّنِّىْ هُدًى فَمَنْ تَبِعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ‏(38)
verses.translation: (38) We said: Go forth from this (state) all; so surely there will come to you a guidance from Me, then whoever follows My guidance, no fear shall come upon them, nor shall they grieve.

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَكَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَآ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ‌‌ۚ هُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ‏(39)
verses.translation: (39) And (as to) those who disbelieve in and reject My communications, they are the inmates of the fire, in it they shall abide.

verses.arabic: يٰبَنِىْٓ اِسْرَآءِيْلَ اذْكُرُوْا نِعْمَتِىَ الَّتِىْٓ اَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَاَوْفُوْا بِعَهْدِىْٓ اُوْفِ بِعَهْدِكُمْۚ وَاِيَّاىَ فَارْهَبُوْنِ‏(40)
verses.translation: (40) O children of Israel! call to mind My favor which I bestowed on you and be faithful to (your) covenant with Me, I will fulfill (My) covenant with you; and of Me, Me alone, should you be afraid.

verses.arabic: وَاٰمِنُوْا بِمَآ اَنْزَلْتُ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ وَلَا تَكُوْنُوْآ اَوَّلَ كَافِرٍۢ بِهٖ‌ وَلَا تَشْتَرُوْا بِاٰيٰتِىْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيْلًا وَّاِيَّاىَ فَاتَّقُوْنِ‏(41)
verses.translation: (41) And believe in what I have revealed, verifying that which is with you, and be not the first to deny it, neither take a mean price in exchange for My communications; and Me, Me alone should you fear.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُوا الْحَقَّ وَاَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(42)
verses.translation: (42) And do not mix up the truth with the falsehood, nor hide the truth while you know (it).

verses.arabic: وَاَقِيْمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتُوا الزَّكٰوةَ وَارْكَعُوْا مَعَ الرّٰكِعِيْنَ‏(43)
verses.translation: (43) And keep up prayer and pay the poor-rate and bow down with those who bow down.

verses.arabic: اَتَاْمُرُوْنَ النَّاسَ بِالْبِرِّ وَتَنْسَوْنَ اَنْفُسَكُمْ وَاَنْتُمْ تَتْلُوْنَ الْكِتٰبَ‌ؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ‏(44)
verses.translation: (44) What! do you enjoin men to be good and neglect your own souls while you read the Book; have you then no sense?

verses.arabic: وَاسْتَعِيْنُوْا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلٰوةِ ‌ؕ وَاِنَّهَا لَكَبِيْرَةٌ اِلَّا عَلَى الْخٰشِعِيْنَۙ‏(45)
verses.translation: (45) And seek assistance through patience and prayer, and most surely it is a hard thing except for the humble ones,

verses.arabic: الَّذِيْنَ يَظُنُّوْنَ اَنَّهُمْ مُّلٰقُوْا رَبِّهِمْ وَاَنَّهُمْ اِلَيْهِ رٰجِعُوْنَ‏(46)
verses.translation: (46) Who know that they shall meet their Lord and that they shall return to Him.

verses.arabic: يٰبَنِىْٓ اِسْرَآءِيْلَ اذْكُرُوْا نِعْمَتِىَ الَّتِىْٓ اَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَاَنِّىْ فَضَّلْتُكُمْ عَلَى الْعٰلَمِيْنَ‏(47)
verses.translation: (47) O children of Israel! call to mind My favor which I bestowed on you and that I made you excel the nations.

verses.arabic: وَاتَّقُوْا يَوْمًا لَّا تَجْزِىْ نَفْسٌ عَنْ نَّفْسٍ شَيْئًا وَّلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا شَفَاعَةٌ وَّلَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌ وَّلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَ‏(48)
verses.translation: (48) And be on your guard against a day when one soul shall not avail another in the least, neither shall intercession on its behalf be accepted, nor shall any compensation be taken from it, nor shall they be helped.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ نَجَّيْنٰکُمْ مِّنْ اٰلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُوْمُوْنَكُمْ سُوْٓءَ الْعَذَابِ يُذَبِّحُوْنَ اَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُوْنَ نِسَآءَكُمْ‌ؕ وَفِىْ ذٰلِكُمْ بَلَاۤءٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيْمٌ‏(49)
verses.translation: (49) And when We delivered you from Firon's people, who subjected you to severe torment, killing your sons and sparing your women, and in this there was a great trial from your Lord.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ فَرَقْنَا بِكُمُ الْبَحْرَ فَاَنْجَيْنٰکُمْ وَاَغْرَقْنَآ اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَاَنْتُمْ تَنْظُرُوْنَ‏(50)
verses.translation: (50) And when We parted the sea for you, so We saved you and drowned the followers of Firon and you watched by.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ وٰعَدْنَا مُوْسٰٓى اَرْبَعِيْنَ لَيْلَةً ثُمَّ اتَّخَذْتُمُ الْعِجْلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ وَاَنْتُمْ ظٰلِمُوْنَ‏(51)
verses.translation: (51) And when We appointed a time of forty nights with Musa, then you took the calf (for a god) after him and you were unjust.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ عَفَوْنَا عَنْكُمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ‏(52)
verses.translation: (52) Then We pardoned you after that so that you might give thanks.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ وَالْفُرْقَانَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُوْنَ‏(53)
verses.translation: (53) And when We gave Musa the Book and the distinction that you might walk aright.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ قَالَ مُوْسٰى لِقَوْمِهٖ يٰقَوْمِ اِنَّكُمْ ظَلَمْتُمْ اَنْفُسَکُمْ بِاتِّخَاذِكُمُ الْعِجْلَ فَتُوْبُوْآ اِلٰى بَارِئِكُمْ فَاقْتُلُوْٓا اَنْفُسَكُمْؕ ذٰ لِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ عِنْدَ بَارِئِكُمْؕ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ‏(54)
verses.translation: (54) And when Musa said to his people: O my people! you have surely been unjust to yourselves by taking the calf (for a god), therefore turn to your Creator (penitently), so kill your people, that is best for you with your Creator: so He turned to you (mercifully), for surely He is the Oft-returning (to mercy), the Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ قُلْتُمْ يٰمُوْسٰى لَنْ نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتّٰى نَرَى اللّٰهَ جَهْرَةً فَاَخَذَتْكُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ وَاَنْتُمْ تَنْظُرُوْنَ‏(55)
verses.translation: (55) And when you said: O Musa! we will not believe in you until we see Allah manifestly, so the punishment overtook you while you looked on.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنٰكُمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ مَوْتِكُمْ لَعَلَّکُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ‏(56)
verses.translation: (56) Then We raised you up after your death that you may give thanks.

verses.arabic: وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْکُمُ الْغَمَامَ وَاَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوٰى‌ؕ كُلُوْا مِنْ طَيِّبٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنٰكُمْ‌ؕ وَمَا ظَلَمُوْنَا وَلٰكِنْ كَانُوْآ اَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُوْنَ‏(57)
verses.translation: (57) And We made the clouds to give shade over you and We sent to you manna and quails: Eat of the good things that We have given you; and they did not do Us any harm, but they made their own souls suffer the loss.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ قُلْنَا ادْخُلُوْا هٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةَ فَکُلُوْا مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ رَغَدًا وَّادْخُلُوا الْبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَّقُوْلُوْا حِطَّةٌ نَّغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطٰيٰكُمْ‌ؕ وَسَنَزِيْدُ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ‏(58)
verses.translation: (58) And when We said: Enter this city, then eat from it a plenteous (food) wherever you wish, and enter the gate making obeisance, and say, forgiveness. We will forgive you your wrongs and give more to those who do good (to others).

verses.arabic: فَبَدَّلَ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا قَوْلاً غَيْرَ الَّذِىْ قِيْلَ لَهُمْ فَاَنْزَلْنَا عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا رِجْزًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَفْسُقُوْنَ‏(59)
verses.translation: (59) But those who were unjust changed it for a saying other than that which had been spoken to them, so We sent upon those who were unjust a pestilence from heaven, because they transgressed.

verses.arabic: وَاِذِ اسْتَسْقَىٰ مُوْسٰى لِقَوْمِهٖ فَقُلْنَا اضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ الْحَجَرَ‌ؕ فَانْفَجَرَتْ مِنْهُ اثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًا‌ؕ قَدْ عَلِمَ کُلُّ اُنَاسٍ مَّشْرَبَهُمْ‌ؕ کُلُوْا وَاشْرَبُوْا مِنْ رِّزْقِ اللّٰهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِىْ الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِيْنَ‏(60)
verses.translation: (60) And when Musa prayed for drink for his people, We said: Strike the rock with your staff. So there gushed from it twelve springs; each tribe knew its drinking place: Eat and drink of the provisions of Allah and do not act corruptly in the land, making mischief.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ قُلْتُمْ يٰمُوْسٰى لَنْ نَّصْبِرَ عَلٰى طَعَامٍ وَّاحِدٍ فَادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخْرِجْ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنْۢبِتُ الْاَرْضُ مِنْۢ بَقْلِهَا وَقِثَّآئِهَا وَفُوْمِهَا وَعَدَسِهَا وَ بَصَلِهَا‌ؕ قَالَ اَتَسْتَبْدِلُوْنَ الَّذِىْ هُوَ اَدْنٰى بِالَّذِىْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ‌ؕ اِهْبِطُوْا مِصْرًا فَاِنَّ لَکُمْ مَّا سَاَلْتُمْ‌ؕ وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الذِّلَّةُ وَالْمَسْکَنَةُ وَبَآءُوْ بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا يَكْفُرُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَيَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّبِيّٖنَ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا وَّڪَانُوْا يَعْتَدُوْنَ‏(61)
verses.translation: (61) And when you said: O Musa! we cannot bear with one food, therefore pray Lord on our behalf to bring forth for us out of what the earth grows, of its herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions. He said: Will you exchange that which is better for that which is worse? Enter a city, so you will have what you ask for. And abasement and humiliation were brought down upon them, and they became deserving of Allah's wrath; this was so because they disbelieved in the communications of Allah and killed the prophets unjustly; this was so because they disobeyed and exceeded the limits.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَالَّذِيْنَ هَادُوْا وَالنَّصٰرٰى وَالصّٰبِئِيْنَ مَنْ اٰمَنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلَهُمْ اَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْۚ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ‏(62)
verses.translation: (62) Surely those who believe, and those who are Jews, and the Christians, and the Sabians, whoever believes in Allah and the Last day and does good, they shall have their reward from their Lord, and there is no fear for them, nor shall they grieve.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ اَخَذْنَا مِيْثَاقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ الطُّوْرَؕ خُذُوْا مَآ اٰتَيْنٰكُمْ بِقُوَّةٍ وَّ اذْكُرُوْا مَا فِيْهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُوْنَ‏(63)
verses.translation: (63) And when We took a promise from you and lifted the mountain over you: Take hold of the law (Tavrat) We have given you with firmness and bear in mind what is in it, so that you may guard (against evil).

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ‌‌ۚ فَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهٗ لَكُنْتُمْ مِّنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ‏(64)
verses.translation: (64) Then you turned back after that; so were it not for the grace of Allah and His mercy on you, you would certainly have been among the losers.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ الَّذِيْنَ اعْتَدَوْا مِنْكُمْ فِىْ السَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُوْنُوْا قِرَدَةً خَاسِئِيْنَ ‌ۚ‏(65)
verses.translation: (65) And certainly you have known those among you who exceeded the limits of the Sabbath, so We said to them: Be (as) apes, despised and hated.

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْنٰهَا نَكٰلاً لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَمَا خَلْفَهَا وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِيْنَ‏(66)
verses.translation: (66) So We made them an example to those who witnessed it and those who came after it, and an admonition to those who guard (against evil).

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ قَالَ مُوْسٰى لِقَوْمِهٖۤ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَاْمُرُكُمْ اَنْ تَذْبَحُوْا بَقَرَةً ‌ ؕ قَالُوْآ اَتَتَّخِذُنَا هُزُوًْا ‌ؕ قَالَ اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ اَنْ اَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِيْنَ‏(67)
verses.translation: (67) And when Musa said to his people: Surely Allah commands you that you should sacrifice a cow; they said: Do you ridicule us? He said: I seek the protection of Allah from being one of the ignorant.

verses.arabic: قَالُوا ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّنْ لَّنَا مَا هِىَ‌ؕ قَالَ اِنَّهٗ يَقُوْلُ اِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا فَارِضٌ وَّلَا بِكْرٌؕ عَوَانٌۢ بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ‌ؕ فَافْعَلُوْا مَا تُؤْمَرُوْنَ‏(68)
verses.translation: (68) They said: Call on your Lord for our sake to make it plain to us what she is. Musa said: He says, Surely she is a cow neither advanced in age nor too young, of middle age between that (and this); do therefore what you are commanded.

verses.arabic: قَالُوا ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّنْ لَّنَا مَا لَوْنُهَا ‌ؕ قَالَ اِنَّهٗ يَقُوْلُ اِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ صَفْرَآءُۙ فَاقِعٌ لَّوْنُهَا تَسُرُّ النّٰظِرِيْنَ‏(69)
verses.translation: (69) They said: Call on your Lord for our sake to make it plain to us what her color is. Musa said: He says, Surely she is a yellow cow; her color is intensely yellow, giving delight to the beholders.

verses.arabic: قَالُوا ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّنْ لَّنَا مَا هِىَۙ اِنَّ الْبَقَرَ تَشٰبَهَ عَلَيْنَا ؕ وَاِنَّآ اِنْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَمُهْتَدُوْنَ‏(70)
verses.translation: (70) They said: Call on your Lord for our sake to make it plain to us what she is, for surely to us the cows are all alike, and if Allah please we shall surely be guided aright.

verses.arabic: قَالَ اِنَّهٗ يَقُوْلُ اِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا ذَلُوْلٌ تُثِيْرُ الْاَرْضَ وَلَا تَسْقِى الْحَرْثَ ‌ۚ مُسَلَّمَةٌ لَّا شِيَةَ فِيْهَا ‌ؕ قَالُوا الْئٰنَ جِئْتَ بِالْحَقِّ‌ؕ فَذَبَحُوْهَا وَمَا كَادُوْا يَفْعَلُوْنَ‏‏(71)
verses.translation: (71) Musa said: He says, Surely she is a cow not made submissive that she should plough the land, nor does she irrigate the tilth; sound, without a blemish in her. They said: Now you have brought the truth; so they sacrificed her, though they had not the mind to do (it).

verses.arabic: وَ اِذْ قَتَلْتُمْ نَفْسًا فَادّٰرَءْتُمْ فِيْهَا ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ مُخْرِجٌ مَّا كُنْتُمْ تَكْتُمُوْنَۚ‏(72)
verses.translation: (72) And when you killed a man, then you disagreed with respect to that, and Allah was to bring forth that which you were going to hide.

verses.arabic: فَقُلْنَا اضْرِبُوْهُ بِبَعْضِهَا ‌ؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُحْىِ اللّٰهُ الْمَوْتٰى ۙ وَيُرِيْکُمْ اٰيٰتِهٖ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَ‏(73)
verses.translation: (73) So We said: Strike the (dead body) with part of the (Sacrificed cow), thus Allah brings the dead to life, and He shows you His signs so that you may understand.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ قَسَتْ قُلُوْبُكُمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ فَهِىَ كَالْحِجَارَةِ اَوْ اَشَدُّ قَسْوَةً ‌ ؕ وَاِنَّ مِنَ الْحِجَارَةِ لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنْهُ الْاَنْهٰرُ‌ؕ وَاِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ الْمَآءُ‌ؕ وَاِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَهْبِطُ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ وَمَا اللّٰهُ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ‏(74)
verses.translation: (74) Then your hearts hardened after that, so that they were like rocks, rather worse in hardness; and surely there are some rocks from which streams burst forth, and surely there are some of them which split asunder so water issues out of them, and surely there are some of them which fall down for fear of Allah, and Allah is not at all heedless of what you do.

verses.arabic: اَفَتَطْمَعُوْنَ اَنْ يُّؤْمِنُوْا لَكُمْ وَقَدْ كَانَ فَرِيْقٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَسْمَعُوْنَ کَلَامَ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُوْنَهٗ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا عَقَلُوْهُ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(75)
verses.translation: (75) Do you then hope that they would believe in you, and a party from among them indeed used to hear the Word of Allah, then altered it after they had understood it, and they know (this).

verses.arabic: وَاِذَا لَقُوْا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا قَالُوْآ اٰمَنَّا  ۖۚ وَاِذَا خَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ اِلٰى بَعْضٍ قَالُوْآ اَ تُحَدِّثُوْنَهُمْ بِمَا فَتَحَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لِيُحَآجُّوْكُمْ بِهٖ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ‌ؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ‏(76)
verses.translation: (76) And when they meet those who believe they say: We believe, and when they are alone one with another they say: Do you talk to them of what Allah has disclosed to you that they may contend with you by this before your Lord? Do you not then understand?

verses.arabic: اَوَلَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوْنَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُوْنَ‏(77)
verses.translation: (77) Do they not know that Allah knows what they keep secret and what they make known?

verses.arabic: وَ مِنْهُمْ اُمِّيُّوْنَ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ الْكِتٰبَ اِلَّاۤ اَمَانِىَّ وَاِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا يَظُنُّوْنَ‏(78)
verses.translation: (78) And there are among them illiterates who know not the Book but only lies, and they do but conjecture.

verses.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ يَكْتُبُوْنَ الْكِتٰبَ بِاَيْدِيْهِمْ ثُمَّ يَقُوْلُوْنَ هٰذَا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ لِيَشْتَرُوْا بِهٖ ثَمَنًا قَلِيْلًا ؕ فَوَيْلٌ لَّهُمْ مِّمَّا کَتَبَتْ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَوَيْلٌ لَّهُمْ مِّمَّا يَكْسِبُوْنَ‏(79)
verses.translation: (79) Woe, then, to those who write the book with their hands and then say: This is from Allah, so that they may take for it a small price; therefore woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوْا لَنْ تَمَسَّنَا النَّارُ اِلَّاۤ اَيَّامًا مَّعْدُوْدَةً ‌ ؕ قُلْ اَتَّخَذْتُمْ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ عَهْدًا فَلَنْ يُّخْلِفَ اللّٰهُ عَهْدَهٗۤ‌ اَمْ تَقُوْلُوْنَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(80)
verses.translation: (80) And they say: Fire shall not touch us but for a few days. Say: Have you received a promise from Allah, then Allah will not fail to perform His promise, or do you speak against Allah what you do not know?

verses.arabic: بَلٰى مَنْ كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةً وَّاَحَاطَتْ بِهٖ خَطِيْۤئَتُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ‌‌ۚ هُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ‏(81)
verses.translation: (81) Yea! whoever earns evil and his sins beset him on every side, these are the inmates of the fire; in it they shall abide.

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ ‌‌ۚ هُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ‏(82)
verses.translation: (82) And (as for) those who believe and do good deeds, these are the dwellers of the garden; in it they shall abide.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ اَخَذْنَا مِيْثَاقَ بَنِىْٓ اِسْرَآءِيْلَ لَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ اِلَّا اللّٰهَ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ اِحْسَانًا وَّذِى الْقُرْبٰى وَالْيَتٰمٰى وَالْمَسٰکِيْنِ وَقُوْلُوْا لِلنَّاسِ حُسْنًا وَّاَقِيْمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتُوا الزَّکٰوةَ ؕ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا مِّنْکُمْ وَاَنْتُمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ‏(83)
verses.translation: (83) And when We made a covenant with the children of Israel: You shall not serve any but Allah and (you shall do) good to (your) parents, and to the near of kin and to the orphans and the needy, and you shall speak to men good words and keep up prayer and pay the poor-rate. Then you turned back except a few of you and (now too) you turn aside.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ اَخَذْنَا مِيْثَاقَكُمْ لَا تَسْفِكُوْنَ دِمَآءَكُمْ وَلَا تُخْرِجُوْنَ اَنْفُسَكُمْ مِّنْ دِيَارِكُمْ ثُمَّ اَقْرَرْتُمْ وَاَنْتُمْ تَشْهَدُوْنَ‏(84)
verses.translation: (84) And when We made a covenant with you: You shall not shed your blood and you shall not turn your people out of your cities; then you gave a promise while you witnessed.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ اَنْتُمْ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ تَقْتُلُوْنَ اَنْفُسَكُمْ وَتُخْرِجُوْنَ فَرِيْقًا مِّنْكُمْ مِّنْ دِيَارِهِمْ تَظٰهَرُوْنَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِالْاِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِؕ وَاِنْ يَّاْتُوْكُمْ اُسٰرٰى تُفٰدُوْهُمْ وَهُوَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيْڪُمْ اِخْرَاجُهُمْ‌‌ؕ اَفَتُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِبَعْضِ الْكِتٰبِ وَتَكْفُرُوْنَ بِبَعْضٍ‌ۚ فَمَا جَزَآءُ مَنْ يَّفْعَلُ ذٰلِكَ مِنْکُمْ اِلَّا خِزْىٌ فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا ‌ۚ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ يُرَدُّوْنَ اِلٰٓى اَشَدِّ الْعَذَابِ‌ؕ وَمَا اللّٰهُ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ‏(85)
verses.translation: (85) Yet you it is who slay your people and turn a party from among you out of their homes, backing each other up against them unlawfully and exceeding the limits; and if they should come to you, as captives you would ransom them-- while their very turning out was unlawful for you. Do you then believe in a part of the Book and disbelieve in the other? What then is the re ward of such among you as do this but disgrace in the life of this world, and on the day of resurrection they shall be sent back to the most grievous chastisement, and Allah is not at all heedless of what you do.

verses.arabic: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ اشْتَرَوُا الْحَيٰوةَ الدُّنْيَا بِالْاٰخِرَةِ‌ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَ‏(86)
verses.translation: (86) These are they who buy the life of this world for the hereafter, so their chastisement shall not be lightened nor shall they be helped.

verses.arabic: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ وَقَفَّيْنَا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ بِالرُّسُلِ‌ وَاٰتَيْنَا عِيْسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ الْبَيِّنٰتِ وَاَيَّدْنٰهُ بِرُوْحِ الْقُدُسِ‌ؕ اَفَكُلَّمَا جَآءَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌۢ بِمَا لَا تَهْوٰٓى اَنْفُسُكُمُ اسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ‌ۚ فَفَرِيْقًا كَذَّبْتُمْ وَفَرِيْقًا تَقْتُلُوْنَ‏(87)
verses.translation: (87) And most certainly We gave Musa the Book and We sent apostles after him one after another; and We gave Isa, the son of Marium, clear arguments and strengthened him with the holy spirit, What! whenever then an apostle came to you with that which your souls did not desire, you were insolent so you called some liars and some you slew.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوْا قُلُوْبُنَا غُلْفٌ‌ؕ بَل لَّعَنَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَقَلِيْلًا مَّا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ‏(88)
verses.translation: (88) And they say: Our hearts are covered. Nay, Allah has cursed them on account of their unbelief; so little it is that they believe.

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ كِتٰبٌ مِّنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْۙ وَكَانُوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ يَسْتَفْتِحُوْنَ عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا  ‌ۖۚ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ مَّا عَرَفُوْا کَفَرُوْا بِهٖ‌ فَلَعْنَةُ اللّٰهِ عَلَى الْكٰفِرِيْنَ‏(89)
verses.translation: (89) And when there came to them a Book from Allah verifying that which they have, and aforetime they used to pray for victory against those who disbelieve, but when there came to them (Prophet) that which they did not recognize, they disbelieved in him; so Allah's curse is on the unbelievers.

verses.arabic: بِئْسَمَا اشْتَرَوْا بِهٖۤ اَنْفُسَهُمْ اَنْ يَّڪْفُرُوْا بِمَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ بَغْيًا اَنْ يُّنَزِّلَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ عَلٰى مَنْ يَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖ‌ۚ فَبَآءُوْ بِغَضَبٍ عَلٰى غَضَبٍ‌ؕ وَلِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ عَذَابٌ مُّهِيْنٌ‏(90)
verses.translation: (90) Evil is that for which they have sold their souls-- that they should deny what Allah has revealed, out of envy that Allah should send down of His grace on whomsoever of His servants He pleases; so they have made themselves deserving of wrath upon wrath, and there is a disgraceful punishment for the unbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمْ اٰمِنُوْا بِمَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ قَالُوْا نُؤْمِنُ بِمَآ اُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَيَكْفُرُوْنَ بِمَا وَرَآءَهٗ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ‌ؕ قُلْ فَلِمَ تَقْتُلُوْنَ اَنْۢبِيَآءَ اللّٰهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ‏(91)
verses.translation: (91) And when it is said to them, Believe in what Allah has revealed, they say: We believe in that which was revealed to us; and they deny what is besides that, while it is the truth verifying that which they have. Say: Why then did you kill Allah's Prophets before if you were indeed believers?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَکُمْ مُّوْسٰى بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ ثُمَّ اتَّخَذْتُمُ الْعِجْلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ وَاَنْتُمْ ظٰلِمُوْنَ‏(92)
verses.translation: (92) And most certainly Musa came to you with clear arguments, then you took the calf (for a god) in his absence and you were unjust.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ اَخَذْنَا مِيْثَاقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَکُمُ الطُّوْرَ ؕ خُذُوْا مَآ اٰتَيْنٰکُمْ بِقُوَّةٍ وَّاسْمَعُوْا ‌ ؕ قَالُوْا سَمِعْنَا وَعَصَيْنَا  وَاُشْرِبُوْا فِىْ قُلُوْبِهِمُ الْعِجْلَ بِکُفْرِهِمْ ‌ؕ قُلْ بِئْسَمَا يَاْمُرُکُمْ بِهٖۤ اِيْمَانُكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ‏(93)
verses.translation: (93) And when We made a covenant with you and raised the mountain over you: Take hold of what We have given you with firmness and be obedient. They said: We hear and disobey. And they were made to imbibe (the love of) the calf into their hearts on account of their unbelief. Say: Evil is that which your belief bids you if you are believers.

verses.arabic: قُلْ اِنْ كَانَتْ لَکُمُ الدَّارُ الْاٰخِرَةُ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ خَالِصَةً مِّنْ دُوْنِ النَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُا الْمَوْتَ اِنْ کُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ‏(94)
verses.translation: (94) Say: If the future abode with Allah is specially for you to the exclusion of the people, then invoke death if you are truthful.

verses.arabic: وَ لَنْ يَّتَمَنَّوْهُ اَبَدًاۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَيْدِيْهِمْ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌۢ بِالظّٰلِمِيْنَ‏(95)
verses.translation: (95) And they will never invoke it on account of what their hands have sent before, and Allah knows the unjust.

verses.arabic: وَلَتَجِدَنَّهُمْ اَحْرَصَ النَّاسِ عَلٰى حَيٰوةٍ  ۛۚ وَ مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ اَشْرَكُوْا‌‌  ۛۚ يَوَدُّ اَحَدُهُمْ لَوْ يُعَمَّرُ اَ لْفَ سَنَةٍ ۚ وَمَا هُوَ بِمُزَحْزِحِهٖ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ اَنْ يُّعَمَّرَ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ بَصِيْرٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُوْنَ ‏(96)
verses.translation: (96) And you will most certainly find them the greediest of men for life (greedier) than even those who are polytheists; every one of them loves that he should be granted a life of a thousand years, and his being granted a long life will in no way remove him further off from the chastisement, and Allah sees what they do.

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَنْ كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّجِبْرِيْلَ فَاِنَّهٗ نَزَّلَهٗ عَلٰى قَلْبِكَ بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَهُدًى وَّبُشْرٰى لِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ‏(97)
verses.translation: (97) Say: Whoever is the enemy of Jibreel-- for surely he revealed it to your heart by Allah's command, verifying that which is before it and guidance and good news for the believers.

verses.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّلّٰهِ وَمَلٰٓئِکَتِهٖ وَ رُسُلِهٖ وَجِبْرِيْلَ وَمِيْكٰٮلَ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَدُوٌّ لِّلْكٰفِرِيْنَ‏(98)
verses.translation: (98) Whoever is the enemy of Allah and His angels and His apostles and Jibreel and Meekaeel, so surely Allah is the enemy of the unbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ اَنْزَلْنَآ اِلَيْكَ اٰيٰتٍۢ بَيِّنٰتٍ‌‌ۚ وَمَا يَكْفُرُ بِهَآ اِلَّا الْفٰسِقُوْنَ‏(99)
verses.translation: (99) And certainly We have revealed to you clear communications and none disbelieve in them except the transgressors.

verses.arabic: اَوَکُلَّمَا عٰهَدُوْا عَهْدًا نَّبَذَهٗ فَرِيْقٌ مِّنْهُمْ‌ؕ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ‏(100)
verses.translation: (100) What! whenever they make a covenant, a party of them cast it aside? Nay, most of them do not believe.

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُوْلٌ مِّنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ نَبَذَ فَرِيْقٌ مِّنَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْكِتٰبَۙ کِتٰبَ اللّٰهِ وَرَآءَ ظُهُوْرِهِمْ كَاَنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(101)
verses.translation: (101) And when there came to them an Apostle from Allah verifying that which they have, a party of those who were given the Book threw the Book of Allah behind their backs as if they knew nothing.

verses.arabic: وَاتَّبَعُوْا مَا تَتْلُوا الشَّيٰطِيْنُ عَلٰى مُلْكِ سُلَيْمٰنَ‌‌ۚ وَمَا کَفَرَ سُلَيْمٰنُ وَلٰكِنَّ الشَّيٰطِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا يُعَلِّمُوْنَ النَّاسَ السِّحْرَ وَمَآ اُنْزِلَ عَلَى الْمَلَکَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَارُوْتَ وَمَارُوْتَ‌ؕ وَمَا يُعَلِّمٰنِ مِنْ اَحَدٍ حَتّٰى يَقُوْلَاۤ اِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْؕ‌ فَيَتَعَلَّمُوْنَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُوْنَ بِهٖ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَ زَوْجِهٖ‌ؕ وَمَا هُمْ بِضَآرِّيْنَ بِهٖ مِنْ اَحَدٍ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ وَيَتَعَلَّمُوْنَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ‌ؕ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوْا لَمَنِ اشْتَرٰٮهُ مَا لَهٗ فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَاقٍ‌ؕ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا بِهٖۤ اَنْفُسَهُمْ‌ؕ لَوْ کَانُوْا يَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(102)
verses.translation: (102) And they followed what the Shaitans chanted of sorcery in the reign of Sulaiman, and Sulaiman was not an unbeliever, but the Shaitans disbelieved, they taught men sorcery and that was sent down to the two angels at Babel, Harut and Marut, yet these two taught no man until they had said, "Surely we are only a trial, therefore do not be a disbeliever." Even then men learned from these two, magic by which they might cause a separation between a man and his wife; and they cannot hurt with it any one except with Allah's permission, and they learned what harmed them and did not profit them, and certainly they know that he who bought it should have no share of good in the hereafter and evil was the price for which they sold their souls; had they but known this.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ اَنَّهُمْ اٰمَنُوْا وَاتَّقَوْا لَمَثُوْبَةٌ مِّنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ خَيْرٌ ؕ‌ لَوْ كَانُوْا يَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(103)
verses.translation: (103) And if they had believed and guarded themselves (against evil), reward from Allah would certainly have been better; had they but known (this).

verses.arabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَقُوْلُوْا رَاعِنَا وَ قُوْلُوا انْظُرْنَا وَاسْمَعُوْا ‌ؕ وَلِلْڪٰفِرِيْنَ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ‏(104)
verses.translation: (104) O you who believe! do not say Raina and say Unzurna and listen, and for the unbelievers there is a painful chastisement.

verses.arabic: مَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ وَلَا الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ اَنْ يُّنَزَّلَ عَلَيْڪُمْ مِّنْ خَيْرٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّکُمْ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهٖ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيْمِ‏(105)
verses.translation: (105) Those who disbelieve from among the followers of the Book do not like, nor do the polytheists, that the good should be sent down to you from your Lord, and Allah chooses especially whom He pleases for His mercy, and Allah is the Lord of mighty grace.

verses.arabic: مَا نَنْسَخْ مِنْ اٰيَةٍ اَوْ نُنْسِهَا نَاْتِ بِخَيْرٍ مِّنْهَآ اَوْ مِثْلِهَا ‌ؕ اَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ‏(106)
verses.translation: (106) Whatever communications We abrogate or cause to be forgotten, We bring one better than it or like it. Do you not know that Allah has power over all things?

verses.arabic: اَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَهٗ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ‌ؕ وَمَا لَکُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ وَّلِىٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيْرٍ‏(107)
verses.translation: (107) Do you not know that Allah's is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and that besides Allah you have no guardian or helper?

verses.arabic: اَمْ تُرِيْدُوْنَ اَنْ تَسْئَلُوْا رَسُوْلَكُمْ كَمَا سُئِلَ مُوْسٰى مِنْ قَبْلُ‌ؕ وَمَنْ يَّتَبَدَّلِ الْکُفْرَ بِالْاِيْمَانِ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ السَّبِيْلِ‏(108)
verses.translation: (108) Rather you wish to put questions to your Apostle, as Musa was questioned before; and whoever adopts unbelief instead of faith, he indeed has lost the right direction of the way.

verses.arabic: وَدَّ کَثِيْرٌ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ لَوْ يَرُدُّوْنَكُمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ اِيْمَانِكُمْ كُفَّارًاۖۚ حَسَدًا مِّنْ عِنْدِ اَنْفُسِهِمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْحَقُّ‌ ۚ فَاعْفُوْا وَاصْفَحُوْا حَتّٰى يَاْتِىَ اللّٰهُ بِاَمْرِهٖ ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى کُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ‏(109)
verses.translation: (109) Many of the followers of the Book wish that they could turn you back into unbelievers after your faith, out of envy from themselves, (even) after the truth has become manifest to them; but pardon and forgive, so that Allah should bring about His command; surely Allah has power over all things.

verses.arabic: وَاَقِيْمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتُوا الزَّکٰوةَ  ‌ؕ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوْا لِاَنْفُسِكُمْ مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوْهُ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرٌ‏(110)
verses.translation: (110) And keep up prayer and pay the poor-rate and whatever good you send before for yourselves, you shall find it with Allah; surely Allah sees what you do.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوْا لَنْ يَّدْخُلَ الْجَنَّةَ اِلَّا مَنْ كَانَ هُوْدًا اَوْ نَصٰرٰى‌ؕ تِلْكَ اَمَانِيُّهُمْ‌ؕ قُلْ هَاتُوْا بُرْهَانَکُمْ اِنْ کُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ‏(111)
verses.translation: (111) And they say: None shall enter the garden (or paradise) except he who is a Jew or a Christian. These are their vain desires. Say: Bring your proof if you are truthful.

verses.arabic: بَلٰى مَنْ اَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهٗ لِلّٰهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَلَهٗۤ اَجْرُهٗ عِنْدَ رَبِّهٖ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ‏(112)
verses.translation: (112) Yes! whoever submits himself entirely to Allah and he is the doer of good (to others) he has his reward from his Lord, and there is no fear for him nor shall he grieve.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَتِ الْيَهُوْدُ لَيْسَتِ النَّصٰرٰى عَلٰى شَىْءٍ وَّقَالَتِ النَّصٰرٰى لَيْسَتِ الْيَهُوْدُ عَلٰى شَىْءٍۙ وَّهُمْ يَتْلُوْنَ الْكِتٰبَؕ كَذٰلِكَ قَالَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِمْ‌ۚ فَاللّٰهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ فِيْمَا كَانُوْا فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ‏(113)
verses.translation: (113) And the Jews say: The Christians do not follow anything (good) and the Christians say: The Jews do not follow anything (good) while they recite the (same) Book. Even thus say those who have no knowledge, like to what they say; so Allah shall judge between them on the day of resurrection in what they differ.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ مَّنَعَ مَسٰجِدَ اللّٰهِ اَنْ يُّذْكَرَ فِيْهَا اسْمُهٗ وَسَعٰى فِىْ خَرَابِهَا ‌ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمْ اَنْ يَّدْخُلُوْهَآ اِلَّا خَآئِفِيْنَ ؕ لَهُمْ فِى الدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌ وَّلَهُمْ فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيْمٌ‏(114)
verses.translation: (114) And who is more unjust than he who prevents (men) from the masjids of Allah, that His name should be remembered in them, and strives to ruin them? (As for) these, it was not proper for them that they should have entered them except in fear; they shall meet with disgrace in this world, and they shall have great chastisement in the hereafter.

verses.arabic: وَلِلّٰهِ الْمَشْرِقُ وَالْمَغْرِبُ‌ فَاَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوْا فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيْمٌ‏(115)
verses.translation: (115) And Allah's is the East and the West, therefore, whither you turn, thither is Allah's purpose; surely Allah is Ample-giving, Knowing.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ وَلَدًا ۙ‌ سُبْحٰنَهٗ ‌ؕ بَل لَّهٗ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ‌ؕ كُلٌّ لَّهٗ قَانِتُوْنَ‏(116)
verses.translation: (116) And they say: Allah has taken to himself a son. Glory be to Him; rather, whatever is in the heavens and the earth is His; all are obedient to Him.

verses.arabic: بَدِيْعُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ‌ؕ وَ اِذَا قَضٰٓى اَمْرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوْلُ لَهٗ كُنْ فَيَكُوْنُ‏(117)
verses.translation: (117) Wonderful Originator of the heavens and the earth, and when He decrees an affair, He only says to it, Be, so there it is.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ لَوْلَا يُكَلِّمُنَا اللّٰهُ اَوْ تَاْتِيْنَآ اٰيَةٌ ‌ ؕ كَذٰلِكَ قَالَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّثْلَ قَوْلِهِمْؕ‌ تَشَابَهَتْ قُلُوْبُهُمْ‌ؕ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا الْاٰيٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يُّوْقِنُوْنَ‏(118)
verses.translation: (118) And those who have no knowledge say: Why does not Allah speak to us or a sign come to us? Even thus said those before them, the like of what they say; their hearts are all alike. Indeed We have made the communications clear for a people who are sure.

verses.arabic: اِنَّاۤ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ بَشِيْرًا وَّنَذِيْرًا ۙ‌ وَّلَا تُسْئَلُ عَنْ اَصْحٰبِ الْجَحِيْمِ‏(119)
verses.translation: (119) Surely We have sent you with the truth as a bearer of good news and as a warner, and you shall not be called upon to answer for the companions of the flaming fire.

verses.arabic: وَلَنْ تَرْضٰى عَنْكَ الْيَهُوْدُ وَلَا النَّصٰرٰى حَتّٰى تَتَّبِعَ مِلَّتَهُمْ‌ؕ قُلْ اِنَّ هُدَى اللّٰهِ هُوَ الْهُدٰى‌ؕ وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ اَهْوَآءَهُمْ بَعْدَ الَّذِىْ جَآءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ‌ۙ مَا لَكَ مِنَ اللّٰهِ مِنْ وَّلِىٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيْرٍؔ‏(120)
verses.translation: (120) And the Jews will not be pleased with you, nor the Christians until you follow their religion. Say: Surely Allah's guidance, that is the (true) guidance. And if you follow their desires after the knowledge that has come to you, you shall have no guardian from Allah, nor any helper.

verses.arabic: اَلَّذِيْنَ اٰتَيْنٰهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ يَتْلُوْنَهٗ حَقَّ تِلَاوَتِهٖؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ‌ ؕ وَمَنْ يَّكْفُرْ بِهٖ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخٰسِرُوْنَ‏(121)
verses.translation: (121) Those to whom We have given the Book read it as it ought to be read. These believe in it; and whoever disbelieves in it, these it is that are the losers.

verses.arabic: يٰبَنِىْٓ اِسْرَآءِيْلَ اذْكُرُوْا نِعْمَتِىَ الَّتِىْٓ اَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَاَنِّىْ فَضَّلْتُكُمْ عَلَى الْعٰلَمِيْنَ‏(122)
verses.translation: (122) O children of Israel, call to mind My favor which I bestowed on you and that I made you excel the nations.

verses.arabic: وَاتَّقُوْا يَوْمًا لَّا تَجْزِىْ نَفْسٌ عَنْ نَّفْسٍ شَيْئًا وَّلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌ وَّلَا تَنْفَعُهَا شَفَاعَةٌ وَّلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَ‏(123)
verses.translation: (123) And be on your guard against a day when no soul shall avail another in the least neither shall any compensation be accepted from it, nor shall intercession profit it, nor shall they be helped.

verses.arabic: وَاِذِ ابْتَلٰٓى اِبْرٰهٖمَ رَبُّهٗ بِكَلِمٰتٍ فَاَتَمَّهُنَّ ‌ؕ قَالَ اِنِّىْ جَاعِلُكَ لِلنَّاسِ اِمَامًا ‌ؕ قَالَ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِىْ ‌ؕ قَالَ لَا يَنَالُ عَهْدِى الظّٰلِمِيْنَ‏(124)
verses.translation: (124) And when his Lord tried Ibrahim with certain words, he fulfilled them. He said: Surely I will make you an Imam of men. Ibrahim said: And of my offspring? My covenant does not include the unjust, said He.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ جَعَلْنَا الْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَاَمْنًا ؕ وَاتَّخِذُوْا مِنْ مَّقَامِ اِبْرٰهٖمَ مُصَلًّى‌ ؕ وَعَهِدْنَآ اِلٰٓى اِبْرٰهٖمَ وَاِسْمٰعِيْلَ اَنْ طَهِّرَا بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِيْنَ وَالْعٰكِفِيْنَ وَالرُّکَّعِ السُّجُوْدِ‏(125)
verses.translation: (125) And when We made the House a pilgrimage for men and a (place of) security, and: Appoint for yourselves a place of prayer on the standing-place of Ibrahim. And We enjoined Ibrahim and Ismail saying: Purify My House for those who visit (it) and those who abide (in it) for devotion and those who bow down (and) those who prostrate themselves.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ قَالَ اِبْرٰهٖمُ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هٰذَا بَلَدًا اٰمِنًا وَّارْزُقْ اَهْلَهٗ مِنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ مَنْ اٰمَنَ مِنْهُمْ بِاللّٰهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ‌ؕ قَالَ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَاُمَتِّعُهٗ قَلِيْلًا ثُمَّ اَضْطَرُّهٗۤ اِلٰى عَذَابِ النَّارِ‌ؕ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيْرُ‏‏(126)
verses.translation: (126) And when Ibrahim said: My Lord, make it a secure town and provide its people with fruits, such of them as believe in Allah and the last day. He said: And whoever disbelieves, I will grant him enjoyment for a short while, then I will drive him to the chastisement of the fire; and it is an evil destination.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ يَرْفَعُ اِبْرٰهٖمُ الْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ وَاِسْمٰعِيْلُؕ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ‌ؕ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ‏(127)
verses.translation: (127) And when Ibrahim and Ismail raised the foundations of the House: Our Lord! accept from us; surely Thou art the Hearing, the Knowing:

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ اُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَاَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا ۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ‏(128)
verses.translation: (128) Our Lord! and make us both submissive to Thee and (raise) from our offspring a nation submitting to Thee, and show us our ways of devotion and turn to us (mercifully), surely Thou art the Oft-returning (to mercy), the Merciful.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَابْعَثْ فِيْهِمْ رَسُوْلًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُوْا عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتِكَ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَ يُزَكِّيْهِمْ‌ؕ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ‏(129)
verses.translation: (129) Our Lord! and raise up in them an Apostle from among them who shall recite to them Thy communications and teach them the Book and the wisdom, and purify them; surely Thou art the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ يَّرْغَبُ عَنْ مِّلَّةِ اِبْرٰهٖمَ اِلَّا مَنْ سَفِهَ نَفْسَهٗ ‌ؕ وَلَقَدِ اصْطَفَيْنٰهُ فِى الدُّنْيَا ‌ۚ وَاِنَّهٗ فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ‏(130)
verses.translation: (130) And who forsakes the religion of Ibrahim but he who makes himself a fool, and most certainly We chose him in this world, and in the hereafter he is most surely among the righteous.

verses.arabic: اِذْ قَالَ لَهٗ رَبُّهٗۤ اَسْلِمْ‌ۙ قَالَ اَسْلَمْتُ لِرَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ‏(131)
verses.translation: (131) When his Lord said to him, Be a Muslim, he said: I submit myself to the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: وَوَصّٰى بِهَآ اِبْرٰهٖمُ بَنِيْهِ وَ يَعْقُوْبُؕ يٰبَنِىَّ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ اصْطَفٰى لَكُمُ الدِّيْنَ فَلَا تَمُوْتُنَّ اِلَّا وَاَنْتُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَؕ‏‏(132)
verses.translation: (132) And the same did Ibrahim enjoin on his sons and (so did) Yaqoub. O my sons! surely Allah has chosen for you (this) faith, therefore die not unless you are Muslims.

verses.arabic: اَمْ كُنْتُمْ شُهَدَآءَ اِذْ حَضَرَ يَعْقُوْبَ الْمَوْتُۙ اِذْ قَالَ لِبَنِيْهِ مَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِىْؕ قَالُوْا نَعْبُدُ اِلٰهَكَ وَاِلٰهَ اٰبَآئِكَ اِبْرٰهٖمَ وَاِسْمٰعِيْلَ وَاِسْحٰقَ اِلٰهًا وَّاحِدًاۖۚ وَّنَحْنُ لَهٗ مُسْلِمُوْنَ‏(133)
verses.translation: (133) Nay! were you witnesses when death visited Yaqoub, when he said to his sons: What will you serve after me? They said: We will serve your God and the God of your fathers, Ibrahim and Ismail and Ishaq, one God only, and to Him do we submit.

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ اُمَّةٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ‌ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُمْ مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ‌ۚ وَلَا تُسْئَلُوْنَ عَمَّا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ‏(134)
verses.translation: (134) This is a people that have passed away; they shall have what they earned and you shall have what you earn, and you shall not be called upon to answer for what they did.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوْا کُوْنُوْا هُوْدًا اَوْ نَصٰرٰى تَهْتَدُوْا ‌ؕ قُلْ بَلْ مِلَّةَ اِبْرٰهٖمَ حَنِيْفًا ‌ؕ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ‏(135)
verses.translation: (135) And they say: Be Jews or Christians, you will be on the right course. Say: Nay! (we follow) the religion of Ibrahim, the Hanif, and he was not one of the polytheists.

verses.arabic: قُوْلُوْٓا اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَمَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْنَا وَمَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلٰٓى اِبْرٰهٖمَ وَاِسْمٰعِيْلَ وَاِسْحٰقَ وَيَعْقُوْبَ وَ الْاَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ اُوْتِىَ مُوْسٰى وَعِيْسٰى وَمَآ اُوْتِىَ النَّبِيُّوْنَ مِنْ رَّبِّهِمْ‌ۚ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ اَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهٗ مُسْلِمُوْنَ‏(136)
verses.translation: (136) Say: We believe in Allah and (in) that which had been revealed to us, and (in) that which was revealed to Ibrahim and Ismail and Ishaq and Yaqoub and the tribes, and (in) that which was given to Musa and Isa, and (in) that which was given to the prophets from their Lord, we do not make any distinction between any of them, and to Him do we submit.

verses.arabic: فَاِنْ اٰمَنُوْا بِمِثْلِ مَآ اٰمَنْتُمْ بِهٖ فَقَدِ اهْتَدَوْا ‌ۚ وَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنَّمَا هُمْ فِىْ شِقَاقٍ‌ ۚ فَسَيَكْفِيْکَهُمُ اللّٰهُ ‌ۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُؕ‏(137)
verses.translation: (137) If then they believe as you believe in Him, they are indeed on the right course, and if they turn back, then they are only in great opposition, so Allah will suffice you against them, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

verses.arabic: صِبْغَةَ اللّٰهِ ‌ۚ وَمَنْ اَحْسَنُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ صِبْغَةً  وَّنَحْنُ لَهٗ عٰبِدُوْنَ‏(138)
verses.translation: (138) (Receive) the baptism of Allah, and who is better than Allah in baptising? and Him do we serve.

verses.arabic: قُلْ اَ تُحَآجُّوْنَنَا فِى اللّٰهِ وَهُوَ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّکُمْۚ وَلَنَآ اَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ اَعْمَالُكُمْۚ وَنَحْنُ لَهٗ مُخْلِصُوْنَۙ‏(139)
verses.translation: (139) Say: Do you dispute with us about Allah, and He is our Lord and your Lord, and we shall have our deeds and you shall have your deeds, and we are sincere to Him.

verses.arabic: اَمْ تَقُوْلُوْنَ اِنَّ اِبْرٰهٖمَ وَاِسْمٰعِيْلَ وَاِسْحٰقَ وَيَعْقُوْبَ وَالْاَسْبَاطَ كَانُوْا هُوْدًا اَوْ نَصٰرٰى‌ؕ قُلْ ءَاَنْتُمْ اَعْلَمُ اَمِ اللّٰهُ‌ ؕ وَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَتَمَ شَهَادَةً عِنْدَهٗ مِنَ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ وَمَا اللّٰهُ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ‏(140)
verses.translation: (140) Nay! do you say that Ibrahim and Ismail and Yaqoub and the tribes were Jews or Christians? Say: Are you better knowing or Allah? And who is more unjust than he who conceals a testimony that he has from Allah? And Allah is not at all heedless of what you do.

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ اُمَّةٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ‌ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُمْ مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ‌ۚ وَلَا تُسْئَلُوْنَ عَمَّا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ‏(141)
verses.translation: (141) This is a people that have passed away; they shall have what they earned and you shall have what you earn, and you shall not be called upon to answer for what they did.
